overnight-oats-beeren.title: Overnight oats with berries and skyr
overnight-oats-beeren.description: Stir it together at night, breakfast is ready in the morning. Creamy, sweet and keeps you going until lunch.
steps: Mix oats, skyr and milk in two jars.
Stir in the honey and cinnamon.
Top with the berries, cover and leave in the fridge overnight.
Give it a quick stir in the morning — done.

ruehrei-vollkorntoast.title: Scrambled eggs with wholemeal toast and ham
ruehrei-vollkorntoast.description: The classic protein breakfast, on the table in ten minutes.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk, salt and pepper.
Melt the butter in a pan and briefly fry the ham.
Pour in the eggs and let them set slowly over medium heat, stirring.
Toast the bread, spoon the eggs on top and sprinkle with chives.
Cook the eggs through properly — that keeps this breakfast safe while breastfeeding.

porridge-apfel-zimt.title: Porridge with apple and cinnamon
porridge-apfel-zimt.description: A warm breakfast for cold mornings — tastes like baked apple.
steps: Bring the oats and milk to a boil and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Dice the apple and add it for the last 3 minutes.
Season with cinnamon and honey.
Serve topped with chopped walnuts.

skyr-bowl-banane.title: Skyr bowl with banana, honey and nuts
skyr-bowl-banane.description: No cooking, lots of protein — the fastest breakfast in the book.
steps: Divide the skyr between two bowls.
Slice the bananas and arrange on top.
Finish with honey, oats and chopped almonds.

protein-pancakes.title: Protein pancakes with quark and apple sauce
protein-pancakes.description: Tastes like a Sunday but fits into any weekday.
steps: Blitz the oats into flour, or use instant oats.
Whisk the quark, eggs, oats and baking powder into a smooth batter.
Fry small pancakes in a little oil over medium heat until golden.
Serve with apple sauce.

griessbrei-beeren.title: Semolina pudding with berries
griessbrei-beeren.description: Childhood food that is grown-up enough for a calorie target.
steps: Bring the milk to a boil with the sugar and vanilla sugar.
Rain in the semolina while stirring and let it swell for 2 minutes.
Warm the berries briefly and spoon them over the pudding.

quark-broetchen.title: Quark rolls with cheese and ham
quark-broetchen.description: Bake once, eat breakfast for half the week. Great for the office too.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C conventional.
Knead the quark, eggs, flour, baking powder and salt into a dough.
Knead in the cheese and diced ham.
Shape six rolls and bake for 25 minutes.
Let them cool — they keep three days in a tin, much longer in the freezer.

haehnchen-reispfanne.title: Chicken and rice pan with peas and sweetcorn
haehnchen-reispfanne.description: One pan, little washing up, and vegetables mild enough that veg-avoiders will eat them.
steps: Slice the chicken, season with salt and sear in oil, then set aside.
Dice the onion and soften it, then toast the rice briefly.
Deglaze with the stock and simmer covered for 15 minutes.
Add the peas and sweetcorn for the last 5 minutes.
Fold the chicken back in and season with paprika, salt and pepper.

fischstaebchen-kartoffelpueree.title: Fish fingers with mashed potato and peas
fischstaebchen-kartoffelpueree.description: Fish only when it is breaded — exactly how it gets eaten in this house.
steps: Peel the potatoes, boil until tender in salted water and drain.
Warm the milk and butter, mash into the potatoes and season with salt and nutmeg.
Bake the fish fingers per the packet instructions until piping hot all the way through.
Cook the peas in a little water for 4 minutes.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.

hackbaellchen-tomatensauce.title: Meatballs in tomato sauce with pasta
hackbaellchen-tomatensauce.description: The safe bet at the family table — and even better the next day.
steps: Knead the mince with the egg, breadcrumbs, half the onion, salt and pepper.
Shape small balls and brown them all over in oil.
Soften the remaining onion and the garlic, then add the passata.
Simmer the meatballs gently in the sauce for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Cook the pasta and serve everything together.

ofenkartoffel-quark.title: Baked potatoes with herb quark and chicken
ofenkartoffel-quark.description: Plenty of protein, barely any effort — the oven does the work.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Wash and halve the potatoes, toss with oil and salt.
Bake on a tray for 40 minutes until crisp outside.
Season the chicken and bake alongside for the last 20 minutes (core temperature 75 °C).
Stir the quark with sparkling water until creamy, fold in the chives, season.
Serve the potatoes, chicken and herb quark together.

putengeschnetzeltes-reis.title: Turkey strips with rice and a light cream sauce
putengeschnetzeltes-reis.description: A lighter take on the classic — cream cheese instead of double cream.
steps: Cook the rice per the packet instructions.
Cut the turkey into strips and sear well in oil, then set aside.
Fry the onion and mushrooms, then deglaze with the stock.
Stir in the cream cheese until the sauce is smooth.
Return the meat to the pan, warm through and serve with the rice.

kaesespaetzle-leicht.title: Lighter cheese spaetzle with crispy onions
kaesespaetzle-leicht.description: Comfort food with a bit less cheese and a bit more quark — still tastes right.
steps: Cook the spaetzle in salted water and drain, saving a little cooking water.
Fry the onion in butter until golden.
Layer the spaetzle in a baking dish with the cheese and quark.
Bake at 180 °C for 10 minutes until the cheese has melted.
Serve topped with the crispy and the fried onions.

mildes-haehnchen-curry.title: Mild chicken curry with rice
mildes-haehnchen-curry.description: Creamy and not spicy at all — curry for people who do not like curry.
steps: Cook the rice.
Dice the chicken and fry it in oil, then add the onion.
Toast the curry powder briefly, then deglaze with stock and coconut milk.
Simmer for 15 minutes and fold in the pineapple at the end.
Season with salt and serve with the rice.

nudelauflauf-haehnchen.title: Pasta bake with chicken and cheese
nudelauflauf-haehnchen.description: Fill the big dish once and have lunch sorted for three days.
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente.
Dice and fry the chicken, softening the onion alongside.
Stir the passata and sour cream together and season.
Mix the pasta, chicken and sauce and tip into a large baking dish.
Scatter over the cheese and bake at 200 °C for 20 minutes.

frikadellen-kartoffelpueree.title: German meat patties with mashed potato
frikadellen-kartoffelpueree.description: A German classic, baked in the oven instead of fried in fat.
steps: Soak the bread roll in water and squeeze it dry.
Knead the mince with the roll, egg, diced onion, mustard, salt and pepper.
Shape flat patties and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Boil the potatoes and mash with warm milk and butter.
Cook the patties right through — nothing should still be pink inside.

haehnchenschnitzel-ofenpommes.title: Breaded chicken schnitzel with oven fries
haehnchenschnitzel-ofenpommes.description: Breaded and crunchy, but from the oven rather than the deep fryer.
steps: Cut the potatoes into batons, toss with oil and salt and bake at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Flatten the chicken breasts, season, then coat in flour, egg and breadcrumbs.
Put the schnitzel on a second tray and spray lightly with oil.
Bake alongside for the last 20 minutes, turning halfway.
Serve with lemon wedges.

gyros-auflauf.title: Gyros bake with potatoes and tzatziki
gyros-auflauf.description: Everything into one dish and into the oven. The tzatziki keeps it fresh.
steps: Mix the pork with the gyros seasoning and oil and leave for 20 minutes.
Slice the potatoes and layer them with onion rings in a baking dish.
Sear the meat hard and spread it over the potatoes.
Bake at 200 °C for 35 minutes, adding the cheese for the last 10.
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it dry and stir with the yoghurt and garlic for the tzatziki.

chili-con-carne-mild.title: Mild chilli con carne with rice
chili-con-carne-mild.description: No heat, plenty of corn and beans — filling and freezes beautifully.
steps: Fry the mince until crumbly and soften the onions alongside.
Season with paprika and cumin, then add the tomatoes.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes.
Stir in the drained beans and sweetcorn and leave for another 5 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve alongside.

tortellini-schinken-sahne.title: Tortellini in a light cheese sauce with ham
tortellini-schinken-sahne.description: Fifteen minutes, one pot, no arguments at the table.
steps: Cook the tortellini per the packet instructions.
Briefly fry the diced ham.
Add the cream cheese and milk and stir until smooth.
Season with parmesan, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Fold in the tortellini and serve immediately.

wraps-haehnchen-frischkaese.title: Chicken and cream cheese wraps
wraps-haehnchen-frischkaese.description: Easy to prepare ahead and good cold out of a lunchbox.
steps: Slice the chicken, season and fry until cooked through.
Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan.
Spread with cream cheese and top with lettuce, chicken and cheese.
Roll up tightly and cut in half.

bratkartoffeln-spiegelei.title: Fried potatoes with fried egg and ham
bratkartoffeln-spiegelei.description: The kind of after-work dinner that tastes like home.
steps: Boil the potatoes the day before, peel and slice them.
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden, turning only late.
Add the onion and ham and fry along.
Fry the eggs in a second pan until the white is firm and the yolk is set — that makes them safe while breastfeeding.

haehnchen-nuggets-kartoffelecken.title: Homemade chicken nuggets with potato wedges
haehnchen-nuggets-kartoffelecken.description: Breaded like the shop-bought kind, except you know what is in them.
steps: Cut the potatoes into wedges, toss with oil, salt and paprika and bake at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Crush the cornflakes roughly.
Cut the chicken into pieces and coat in flour, egg and cornflakes.
Put on a tray and bake alongside for 18 minutes, turning once.
Cut a nugget open before serving to check it is cooked through.

hackbraten-kartoffeln.title: Meatloaf with potatoes and a light gravy
hackbraten-kartoffeln.description: A Sunday roast that produces leftovers for Monday.
steps: Knead the mince with the eggs, breadcrumbs, onions, mustard, salt and pepper.
Shape into a loaf and bake at 180 °C for 50 minutes.
Boil the potatoes in salted water.
Bring the roasting juices to a boil with the stock, stir in the sour cream and season.
Slice the meatloaf — the middle has to be cooked through.

quesadillas-haehnchen.title: Chicken and cheese quesadillas
quesadillas-haehnchen.description: Crisp from the pan and ready in twenty minutes.
steps: Dice the chicken finely, season and fry until cooked through.
Lay a tortilla in a dry pan and top with cheese, chicken and sweetcorn.
Add a second tortilla and cook golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream.

nudelsalat-haehnchen-mais.title: Pasta salad with chicken and sweetcorn
nudelsalat-haehnchen-mais.description: The meal-prep hero: make it once, eat lunch for three days.
steps: Cook the pasta, rinse cold and drain well.
Fry the chicken, let it cool and dice it.
Whisk the yoghurt, mayonnaise, a splash of gherkin brine, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Mix everything with the sweetcorn, diced gherkins and onion.
Leave to sit for at least an hour.

kartoffelgulasch-wuerstchen.title: Potato goulash with sausages
kartoffelgulasch-wuerstchen.description: One pot, cheap ingredients, warms you from the inside.
steps: Soften the onions in oil and briefly toast the paprika.
Add the diced potatoes and top up with tomatoes and stock.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender.
Slice the sausages and heat through for the last 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.

backfisch-kartoffelsalat.title: Breaded fried fish with potato salad
backfisch-kartoffelsalat.description: Battered-style fish — breaded, crunchy, with the fish flavour well in the background.
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel and slice them.
Pour over the warm stock with the diced onion and leave for 20 minutes.
Fold in the gherkins and mayonnaise and season with salt and pepper.
Bake the fish per the packet instructions until golden and cooked through.
Serve with lemon.

bulgur-hackpfanne.title: Bulgur and mince pan with sweetcorn
bulgur-hackpfanne.description: Like a rice pan, only with more bite and more fibre.
steps: Fry the mince until crumbly and soften the onion alongside.
Toast the bulgur briefly, then deglaze with stock and passata.
Leave covered to swell for 12 minutes.
Fold in the sweetcorn and season with paprika, salt and pepper.

ofen-feta-nudeln.title: Baked feta pasta
ofen-feta-nudeln.description: The internet classic, kept mild: feta, tomatoes, pasta, done.
steps: Put the feta in the middle of a baking dish and scatter the tomatoes around it.
Drizzle with oil, garlic and oregano.
Bake at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Cook the pasta and stir everything together in the dish until creamy.
Use pasteurised feta only — then the dish is safe while breastfeeding.

haehnchenbrust-kraeuterkruste.title: Chicken breast with a herb crust and rice
haehnchenbrust-kraeuterkruste.description: The leanest main in the book and still juicy.
steps: Mix the breadcrumbs, chopped parsley, parmesan and soft butter into a crust.
Season the chicken, put it in a dish and spread the crust on top.
Bake at 190 °C for 22 minutes until the core temperature reaches 75 °C.
Cook the rice and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

toast-hawaii-leicht.title: Lighter toast Hawaii
toast-hawaii-leicht.description: Nostalgia in twelve minutes, with turkey ham instead of cooked ham.
steps: Toast the bread lightly.
Top with ham, a pineapple ring and cheese.
Grill at 220 °C top heat for 8 minutes until the cheese colours.
Serve with a little salad on the side.

pfannkuchen-apfelmus.title: Pancakes with apple sauce
pfannkuchen-apfelmus.description: A sweet main course — always welcome at the family table.
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, sugar and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter.
Let it rest for 20 minutes.
Fry thin pancakes in a little butter.
Serve with apple sauce.

milchreis-zimt.title: Rice pudding with cinnamon sugar
milchreis-zimt.description: Twenty minutes of stirring for a plate of pure contentment.
steps: Bring the milk to a boil with the vanilla sugar and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the rice and let it swell over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring often.
Serve dusted with cinnamon and sugar.

kaiserschmarrn-apfelmus.title: Kaiserschmarrn with apple sauce
kaiserschmarrn-apfelmus.description: Fluffy, sweet and a good reason not to eat out on a Sunday.
steps: Separate the eggs and whisk the whites to stiff peaks.
Mix the flour, yolks and milk, then fold in the whites.
Fry the batter with the raisins in butter, tear into pieces and caramelise.
Dust with icing sugar and serve with apple sauce.
Leave out the rum — that keeps it breastfeeding-friendly.

skyr-beeren-snack.title: Skyr with berries
skyr-beeren-snack.description: The default snack: lots of protein, barely any calories.
steps: Let the berries thaw and stir them into the skyr.

apfel-erdnussmus.title: Apple with peanut butter
apfel-erdnussmus.description: Sweet, salty, crunchy — gets you through the afternoon.
steps: Cut the apple into wedges and dip them into the peanut butter.

huettenkaese-brot.title: Cottage cheese on wholemeal bread
huettenkaese-brot.description: A savoury snack that fills you up without sitting heavy.
steps: Spread the bread with cottage cheese, season with salt and pepper and scatter over the chives.

protein-shake-banane.title: Banana protein shake
protein-shake-banane.description: After training, or when things need to be quick.
steps: Blend everything together.
While breastfeeding, pick a plain whey protein without caffeine or herbal additives.

quark-honig-snack.title: Low-fat quark with honey and cinnamon
quark-honig-snack.description: For the evening on the sofa — tastes like dessert, counts as protein.
steps: Stir the quark with a little water until creamy and fold in the honey and cinnamon.

reiswaffeln-frischkaese.title: Rice cakes with cream cheese and ham
reiswaffeln-frischkaese.description: Crunchy, barely any crumbs, works anywhere.
steps: Spread the rice cakes with cream cheese and top with the ham.

bananenbrot-scheibe.title: Banana bread
bananenbrot-scheibe.description: Bake once and have an honest snack in the house all week.
steps: Mash the bananas and mix with the quark and eggs.
Stir in the oats, baking powder, cinnamon and chopped nuts.
Pour into a loaf tin and bake at 175 °C for 45 minutes.
Cool completely and cut into ten slices.

studentenfutter-portion.title: Nuts and dried fruit
studentenfutter-portion.description: A weighed portion — otherwise the snack quickly turns into a meal.
steps: Weigh out 35 g into a small tin — do not eat straight from the bag.
